x-okf-proposal-guidance.summary: a defect: the code does something other than what it is meant to do.
x-okf-proposal-guidance.question: Does the source show the code behaving wrongly against a known intended behaviour?
signals: a concrete input or state produces a wrong output, a crash or data loss
the intended behaviour is known and the actual one differs
it can be reproduced or pinned to a code path
anti_signals: the code works as designed and the design itself is in question
the work adds a capability rather than repairing one
the gap is missing test coverage, not wrong behaviour
x-okf-proposal-guidance.title_pattern: Names the defect: `<Component> <does the wrong thing> when <condition>`
